digest.component_or_area: Pandoc corpus verification and test infrastructure
propositions: Gerrit Verify runs thousands of real Pandoc subprocess conversions over the complete DC wiki corpus, consuming at least 184.32 seconds on the macOS critical path.

ADR 0095 requires every conversion assertion to use the real Pandoc binary; a narrow superseding ADR is required to move complete corpus replay to external integration without relaxing production renderer invariants.
The approved design retains three representative live corpus bodies and compact provenance probes in Gerrit Verify, with all assertion classes tested against committed outputs.

Complete real-Pandoc corpus replay will move to a dedicated weekly/manual job in external-integration.yml with ubuntu-latest and macos-latest matrix, requiring future implementation to add macOS runner support.
Pandoc version drift and platform-specific binary fingerprints must fail fast, with deterministic fixture regeneration remaining available and paired A/B implementation evidence required.
